name: Balbani sultanate of Bengal
alt: Independent Bengal of Bughra Khan and Shamsuddin Firoz Shah

predecessors.name: Mamluk dynasty of Delhi
predecessors.text: Bengal inside Cliopatria's 1285 Mamluk outline (the mamluk-dynasty dossier's successor land)

successors.name: Tughlaq dynasty
successors.text: Bengal as Cliopatria's Tughlaq 1326 shape holds it (the tughlaq-dynasty dossier's region)

ledger.x: 1301: Satgaon and the Sundarbans come into the kingdom.
ledger.cp: local rulers of Satgaon and the Sundarbans (unnamed on the page)

ledger.x: 1301: Sonargaon and the Dhaka country come into the kingdom.
1301 (bridge): Firoz Shah holds Bihar against the Delhi Khaljis.

ledger.cp: rulers of Sylhet (unnamed on the page)

ledger.x: 1320 (bridge): the Khalji dynasty of Delhi falls, ending the Khalji-Bengal contest for Bihar.
1324: Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq turns on Bengal.
1325: the independent Bengal of Bughra Khan's line ends.

wars.name: Conquest of Sylhet (1303)
wars.outcome: 'According to an inscription Firuz Shah conquered Sylhet in 1303 CE.'

wars.name: Khalji-Bengal frontier in Bihar
wars.outcome: Firoz Shah 'held Bihar firmly against the Khaljis'; no campaign is dated.

wars.name: Tughlaq conquest of Bengal
wars.outcome: Tughluq took Bengal 'then in the midst of a civil war': Nasiruddin was placed on the throne of West Bengal as a vassal and East Bengal annexed.

certainty.note: The only frontier statements are the rivers Son and Ghogra in the west, Dinajpur-Rangpur in the north, Hooghly and the Sundarbans in the south, Sylhet in the east (Firoz Shah's reign); none is a survey line.
